folderUid.description: The UID of the folder that contains the dashboard.

message.description: A message describing the dashboard change.

definitionJson.description: A JSON object containing dashboard fields such as panels, tags, templating, and time settings.

parentUid.description: The parent folder UID. Omit for a root-level folder.

type.description: The data source plugin type, for example prometheus.

access.description: The access mode. Grafana commonly uses proxy.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default data source.

withCredentials.description: Whether credentials are sent with cross-site requests.

jsonDataJson.description: A JSON object containing plugin-specific non-secret configuration.

secureJsonDataJson.description: A JSON object containing plugin-specific secret configuration.

uid.description: The stable Grafana data source UID.

baseUrl.description: The absolute Grafana URL. The /api suffix is optional.

token.description: A Grafana service account token or an Azure Managed Grafana Microsoft Entra access token.

samples.title: Basic Grafana resources
samples.description: Creates a Grafana folder, data source and dashboard.
